guard_streams.source: Ofcom upgrading landlines to digital technology and future of landline calls

facts.detail: Future landline calls are delivered using Voice over Internet Protocol, also described as digital phone or digital voice.
Customers do not need to act until their provider contacts them about the service change.
Customers retaining a landline after PSTN retirement generally need a suitable connection even if they do not use broadband services.
Ofcom expects options for landline-only users so they should not be forced to buy a high-speed broadband package.

guard_streams.write_limit: Migration process and connection requirements do not prove parcel-level serviceability or speed.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom upgrading landlines to digital technology

facts.detail: Some fire alarms, burglar alarms and telecare devices that use a phone line may be affected by migration.
Customers should tell the provider about dependent devices before migration.
Affected devices may need replacement or reconfiguration to continue working.
Where new equipment or a suitable service installation is needed, the provider should arrange it.

guard_streams.write_limit: Device compatibility and migration support cannot populate exact parcel coverage fields.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom upgrading landlines to digital technology and future of landline calls

facts.detail: A digital landline connected through a broadband router normally stops working during a power cut because the router uses mains power.
Protection applies particularly where a customer lacks a mobile phone, cannot use one or has no indoor mobile signal.
The provider must ensure dependent customers can contact emergency services during a power cut.
A solution may include battery backup for the landline or a basic mobile phone.

guard_streams.write_limit: Power-cut solutions and dependency status are not exact network measurements.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom protecting customers during digital-landline migration and provider-rules summary

facts.detail: Providers should communicate effectively about power-cut risks and available protection.
Providers should identify customers whose circumstances require emergency-call resilience.
The protection solution should enable emergency access for at least one hour during a power cut.
The solution should be free for customers who depend on the landline to call emergency services.

guard_streams.write_limit: Minimum resilience requirements cannot establish exact parcel availability.

guard_streams.source: Ofcom emergency-services access during power outages compliance

facts.detail: General Condition A3.2(b) requires uninterrupted access to emergency organisations for offered voice communications services.
Traditional PSTN copper lines can remain powered from the telephone exchange during a premises power cut.
VoIP calls require additional measures during a power outage because premises broadband equipment needs mains power.
Ofcom's compliance work included alternative-network and VoIP providers and engagement on obligations affecting FTTP services.

guard_streams.write_limit: Regulatory compliance monitoring is not accepted parcel coverage evidence.

facts.detail: Caller display can help users decide whether to answer and report unwanted calls when a number is presented.
The displayed number may be false or may mimic an unrelated person or company because of number spoofing.
Provider filtering can route blocklisted, user-blocked, withheld or international calls to blocking or junk-voicemail services.
Anonymous-call rejection blocks withheld numbers but can also block legitimate calls from organisations that withhold numbers.

guard_streams.write_limit: Call-display and filtering functions do not prove broadband or mobile service at a parcel.

facts.detail: Malicious, abusive or threatening calls can constitute a criminal offence.
Recipients should contact their phone company's nuisance or malicious-calls team and describe what was said.
A real and immediate threat to the recipient or family should be reported to 999.
Threats believed not to be immediate should be reported to local police through 101.

guard_streams.write_limit: Safety advice and crime reporting do not establish parcel connectivity.
